🔖 build(release): 发布 v0.1.7

- 更新应用与 OpenClaw 插件版本到 0.1.7

✨ feat(runtime): 增加指标和重试策略

- 抽取 run lifecycle 并新增 metrics endpoint
- 增加有限自动重试、SQLite PRAGMA 和默认列表 limit
- 扩展 ISO duration 并加入元数据一致性检查

⚡️ perf(storage): 增加索引与幂等冲突检测

- 增加 SQLite schema 迁移、结构化查询列和关键索引
- 下推 confirm_latest 与 due delivery 查询
- 检测同一 idempotency_key 的不同请求体冲突
- 更新需求文档和技术方案

🐛 fix(schedule): 修复时区调度与配置 reload

- 拒绝无时区的具体时间输入
- 按 schedule.timezone 解释 recurring RRULE
- 支持显式 reload executor 和全局 quiet_policy
- 更新 skills、插件和安装文档

fix(xlsx): ROW/COLUMN on computed arrays surface #REF! instead of silent null

ROW({1,2,3}) and ROW(A1:A3*2) previously fell through the
BaseRow>0 gate, hit the regex-based cell-ref fallback, failed to
match, and returned null — which callers (and view text) silently
coerce to 0. Agents got "0" with no signal that the call was
meaningless.

A computed array has no workbook origin (BaseRow=0), so ROW/COLUMN
have no defined row/column identity. Surface #REF! explicitly,
mirroring POI's CacheAreaEv

security(mcp): cap RateLimiter map size with LRU eviction (S6)

The rate limiter's attempts map was unbounded. Many distinct source IPs
(spoofed, NAT/CDN, real diversity) grew the map until the periodic
5-minute cleanup ran, allowing a memory-DoS window.

Cap at MaxRateLimiterEntries (10k) and evict on insert when full: first
drop already-expired entries, then evict the one with the oldest resetAt.
Track EvictionCount for monitoring.

Switched the email_account_add tool's SMTP defaults from 465/SMTPS to
587/STARTTLS. Most cloud hosting providers (Hetzner, AWS, GCP, etc.)
block outbound TCP 25 and 465 by default to prevent spam abuse; port
587 is the modern submission port and is almost always reachable.

were dispatched to the skill. Replies during a multi-turn conversation

platform instead of reaching the skill.

(via has_active_session() in session_bridge.py) so any reply is routed
correctly until the session ends.

fix(imap): filter UIDs client-side to avoid re-processing on empty range

IMAP servers return the highest existing UID when the requested range
(lastUid+1):* is beyond the inbox's highest UID — they don't return an
empty result. Without client-side filtering, the same mail gets fetched
and turned into a new approval on every poll tick (observed: 5 approvals
in 5 minutes for uid=13).

Fix: filter the search result with `u > lastUid` before slicing.

believed the full edit was delivered and never recovered, silently
dropping everything past the truncation boundary on long replies.

fix(sse): HTTP/2-safe SSE wrapper — drop forbidden Transfer-Encoding header

Hono's streamSSE() unconditionally sets Transfer-Encoding: chunked
(plus Connection: keep-alive), both of which HTTP/2 forbids per
RFC 7540. The @hono/node-server adapter passes those through to
Http2ServerResponse.writeHead, which throws
ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_CONNECTION_HEADERS, the SSE handler dies, the
client EventSource sees the connection drop, the web client renders
"offline".

rebuilt before host restart), the on_wake column won't exist and
the query crashes, causing a restart loop.

Detect the column via PRAGMA table_info and conditionally include
the filter clause.
